skill.summary: Skip the learning curve of professional editing software. Describe what you want — cut out silences, add background music, and export as MP4 — and get edited...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Editor AB2N with cloud-based AI video editing.
- Seamless workflow: upload video (up to 500MB), describe edits (e.g., cut silences, add music), and export as MP4.
- Automatic setup and authentication with environment token or anonymous onboarding.
- Clear session and credit management with transparent error handling.
- Supports a wide range of video/audio/image formats and common creator workflows.
- Responsive feedback loop: setup notifications ("Connecting...", "Ready!") and progress updates.
